subject: Minute-scale surge uplift voucher and settlement path
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@archivex.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T09:02:00Z
Subject: Quick ask — minute-scale uplift for feature launch

Hi Ava,

We have a hard cutover for a new feature on Fri 9/17 and expect a short spike in inference traffic for roughly 90 minutes at peak. Can Redwood provide a short-duration capacity uplift (minute-scale) and an all-in blended rate for that window?

Questions:
- Can you guarantee an instant uplift without re-architecting our integration?
- What does the invoicing and true-up look like (we prefer a single line item on the monthly invoice)?
- Any waivers on overrun surcharge if we stay within an agreed minute-by-minute cap?

We currently run on your Pay-as-you-go plan with a standing PO (PO# 33219). Procurement may push for Net 60. I attached a rough expected volume file.

Thanks,
Samir
VP Engineering, Archivex

Attachment: capacity_estimate_Q3_launch.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@archivex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T10:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask — minute-scale uplift for feature launch

Samir — thanks for the heads up and the estimate. We can support an instantaneous uplift via our provisional "minute-scale voucher" flow without code changes on your side. High level options:

1) Minute voucher (recommended for 60-180min):
   - Blended uplift voucher rate (pre-approved blended per-token rate for the window)
   - One-time temporary cap configured at the account level; automatic rollback after window closes
   - Post-window true-up: usage line item + small settlement credit if committed cushion unused

2) Short-term commit (2–4 weeks):
   - Slightly better unit economics but takes legal/PO confirmation

For your Friday window, I recommend option 1. I attached our provisional rate sheet and a quick capable config I can provision. If Procurement needs Net 60, we can accept that but it will slightly extend approval timing.

Please confirm: 1) desired uplift start/end times (UTC) and 2) tolerance for a 5% overrun buffer (we can either absorb a portion or apply a reduced surcharge). If you want a fixed all-in invoice line, we can issue a proforma with a blended quantity estimate and true-up note.

Next steps: I can provision the voucher once Ben and Laura sign off on the discount concessions.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: provisional_rate_sheet_v3.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T12:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Quick ask — minute-scale uplift for feature launch

Looping in Laura for approval. Ava — based on their size (PO 33219) and the short window, I'm comfortable approving a one-off blended voucher at a modest discount to paygo (we should preserve margin). Suggested commercial:

- Blended uplift voucher rate = 0.92x current PAYG rate (single line item for the uplift window)
- 5% soft overrun buffer we absorb up to $X (we should cap absolute exposure at $2k)
- True-up: final invoice will show the voucher line (blended estimate) and an adjustment line for actual usage. Any unused cushion is credited back the following invoice.

If Procurement insists on Net 60, we keep the same commercial but escrow the voucher activation until PO is acknowledged. Laura — can we approve the blended rate and the $2k exposure cap? If yes, Ava please provision and send DocuSign amendment.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Director, Sales | Redwood Inference

Quoted attachments: signed-amendment-template.docx (template stub)

From: Procurement Team <procurement@archivex.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@archivex.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T14:40:00Z

Hi Ava / Ben,

Thanks for the fast follow. A few procurement items to confirm before we sign:
- We require a single consolidated invoice line for October (no intra-month billing) and a short true-up note is acceptable.
- Payment terms: Net 60 is preferred. Please confirm if Redwood will accept Net 60 for this one-off uplift.
- Can you provide a SOC2 excerpt or audit pointer for the temporary voucher activation and logging? We need evidence we can share with our internal auditors.

If you can accept Net 60 and provide the SOC2 pointer, we'll escalate PO issuance today.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Archivex

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-09-09T17:28:00Z

Thanks — we can do this. Confirming commercial and operational points:

- Approved: one-off blended uplift voucher at 0.92x PAYG rate for the configured window.
- Overrun policy: Redwood will absorb overruns up to $2,000 total exposure. Anything above that will be billed at the standard PAYG rate and reflected as an adjustment on the next invoice.
- Invoice: single consolidated line in October; final true-up line item with quantity and delta will appear on that invoice.
- Terms: Net 60 accepted for this one-off uplift (we'll note in the amendment).
- Audit evidence: SOC2 pointer: https://redwoodinference.com/security/soc2-summary.pdf — this covers audit controls around temporary capacity provisioning and audit logging.

Ava — please provision the voucher for 2026-09-17T20:00:00Z to 2026-09-17T21:30:00Z (90 minutes) and send DocuSign amendment to procurement@archivex.com. Ben — please confirm the DocuSign text matches the $2k exposure cap and blended rate. Samir — once procurement signs we will activate immediately.
